title: Navigating change: Why managed services make sense for insurance carriers
summary: The property and casualty insurance industry continues to face economic pressures, talent shortages, and the need to adapt quickly in a climate of rapid change. According to our latest Voice of Our Clients research, difficulty hiring IT talent continues to be a top challenge across the industry. Many carriers struggle to train talent fast enough to keep pace with digital modernization requirements and changing customer expectations.
